spans.s:
तड् तड्, cl. 10. P. ताडयति, -यितुम्, अती-
तडत् (redupl. perf. तताड), to beat, strike,
hit, knock; to strike with arrows, wound, punish; to
strike a musical instrument; (in astronomy) to strike
against, touch, partially obscure or eclipse; (in arith-
metic) to multiply; to speak; to shine; [cf. Hib.
tathaim, ‘I kill, destroy;’ tathog, ‘a clash, a slap.’]

तडित्, त्, f., Ved. (in Ṛg-veda तऌइत्), lightning;
तऌइत् or तऌइतस्, ind. closely, near, (as it were
striking against.)
—तडित्-कुमार, आस्, m. pl. (with
[]
Jainas) N. of a class of deities belonging to the
Bhavana-patis.
—तडित्-प्रभा, f., N. of one of
the Mātṛs attendant on Skanda.
—तडित्-वत्,
आन्, अती, अत्, having lightning, emitting lightning,
flashing; (आन्), m. a cloud, a kind of Cyperus, =
मुस्तक.
—तडिद्-गर्भ, अस्, m. a cloud, ‘con-
taining lightning.’
—तडिन्-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, con-
sisting of lightning, flashing like lightning.
—तडिन्-
मालावलम्बिन् (˚ला-अव्˚), ई, इनी, इ, having garlands
of lightning hanging down.
—तडिल्-लता, f. forked
lightning.
—तडिल्-लेखा, f. a line or streak of lightning.
तडित् तडित्. See तड्, col. 2.
तडग तडग, अस्, m. = तडाग, a pool, lake.

तडाग, अस्, अम्, m. n. a pond or pool deep enough
for the growth of the lotus &c.; a tank; a trap for
catching deer.
—तडाग-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having
pools or lakes; (आन्), m., scil. देश, a district.

ताडाग ताडाग, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. तडाग), being
in tanks, coming from ponds (as water &c.).

ताडका, f., N. of a Yakṣiṇī or female fiend,
daughter of Su-ketu, wife of Sunda, and mother of
Mārīca, (she was changed into a Rākṣasī by Agastya,
whose devotions she had disturbed, and was afterwards
killed by Rāma, see Rāmāyaṇa

); the large
dark-green pumpkin.
—ताडका-फल, अम्, n. large
cardamoms.
तडाकिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having pools or lakes.

तडाघात तडाघात, अस्, m. a blow from an
elephant's uplifted trunk; probably a wrong form
for ताडाघात (ताड-आघात).

ताड ताड, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. तड्), beating,
striking; (अस्), m. a blow, thump, knock, beating,
whipping, chastisement; sound, noise; a handful of
grass, corn, &c., a sheaf; a mountain; a kind of grass,
Andropogon Serratus, = देवताड; [cf. ताडि next col.]
—ताड-घ, अस्, आ, अम्, beating with a whip or
strokes of any kind; (अस्), m. a blacksmith (?).
—ताड-घात, अस्, m. an artificer who beats or
hammers, a smith.
—ताड-वक्र, N. of a district.
ताडकायन, अस्, m., N. of a Ṛṣi.

ताडन, अस्, आ, अम्, beating, whipping, striking,
hitting, hurting; (अम्), n. the act of striking, beating,
thumping, whipping, chastising, a stroke, blow; (in
astron.) touching, partial eclipse; (आ), f. striking;
(ई), f. a whip.
ताडनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be beaten, punishable.

ताडयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, a striker, beater, thumper,
who or what beats or strikes.
ताडयित्वा, ind. having beaten or struck.
ताडित, अस्, आ, अम्, struck, beaten, chastised.

ताडुल, अस्, आ, अम्, beating, who or what beats
or strikes, punishing with blows.

ताड्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be beaten or chastised or
punished, punishable.

ताडङ्क ताडङ्क, अस्, m. or ताडपत्त्र, अम्,
n. a kind of ear-ring or ornament of the ear; [cf.
ताटङ्क.]

ताडि ताडि, इस् or ई f. (for ताली), a kind of
palm, Corypha Taliera; (ई), f. a kind of ornament.
